ih: the fallback for an attack pattern's fireballBeats (a?.fireballBeats ?? ih)
th: inferred: a 32-bit integer mixing hash; callers take one bit of the result or divide it by 2^32
ph: inferred: maps fireballBeats to beatStartTick + beat * beatIntervalTicks + 3, the tick each burst's first fireball starts
lV: the object { encounter: "yama_p3", type: "spawn-fireball" }; the command of the debug action "Spawn Fireball"
oV: the object { encounter: "yama_p3", type: "spawn-void-flare" }; the command of the debug action "Spawn Void Flare"
rh: its value is "detonated"; assigned to actor.deathCause and used as a key of deathClips
FA: returns levels.hitpoints of a monster table entry; a caller's error string "Missing Colosseum monster data for ..."
EA: error strings "Missing monster formula stats for NPC 14179" and "Missing Phase 3 Yama formula stats"; stored under formulaStats; handed to zebakDefinition as stats
gM: handed to zebakDefinition as startNpcDeath: gM; it makes the death record with causeStage "scripted"
ET: error string "NPC definition '...' has invalid spawnUntargetableTicks"
eU: raises vitals.hp and emits "hitsplat_spawned" with hitsplatType "heal"; its result is stored under the key heal
wV: its value is Kz.VFX_VOIDFLARE_HUMAN_IMPACT_BLUE; passed as spotAnimId
hM: the engine stores its result as targetDistance and as const distance (player tile, target.position, target.size)
NM: its other caller stores the result under the key accuracy; Yama compares it with accuracyRandom() for accuracySucceeded
OM: handed out under the key targetPrayerMultipliers
wT: callers' error strings "Yama cannot roll accuracy without formula stats" and "Zuk requires formula stats"; inferred otherwise: formulaStats with the debuffs' drains taken off the levels
AT: inferred: the player counterpart ({ kind: "player", levels, stance }), passed under the key target of an accuracy roll
nd: it sets window.__log and prints "Logger commands:"
rf: its members (TICK_START, FIREBALL_SPAWN, ...) are the type of the events passed to logEvent()
pN: returns { phase: "falling" | "impact" | "explosion" | "done", progress }; the event "fireball_impact" is emitted on its "impact"
yN: the tiles returned while the phase is "impact" (center, side1, side2)
wN: the tiles returned while the phase is "explosion"
Nl: returns bounds of the arena config in force ({ bounds, walkableTiles, collisionMap })
Ul: inferred: looks a tile up in walkableTiles of the arena config in force
Kl: inferred: the cache manager stores here what it builds under the profiler label "CacheManager.buildArenaConfig" (log "Arena bounds extracted")
me: handed to zebakDefinition as seedRandom: me; the engine does this.combatRandom = me(this.combatSeed)
uh: feeds basePosition of the render config's primaryNpc with actorId "yama" (through Mh); Yama's actor is created at it
vh: inferred: y <= 19; getArenaConfig drops those walkable tiles to make sealedArenaConfig
ZH: the engine's canAttackerAct(worldState, attacker) returns it for an npc
NT: the engine keeps one as this.npcDefinitions; it holds registrations and throws DuplicateNpcDefinitionError
BN: inferred: returns { tp, cycleNum }, the ticks into the wave period and the number of the period, for a wave's delta
WN: inferred: false before cycle 0, and in cycle 0 true only for deltas listed in firstCycleDeltas
RN: inferred: true when y - x is within -19..19 and x + y within 40..81; wave tiles outside it are skipped
_N: inferred: used when waves.randomOffsets is true; picks one of four offset pairs by a hash of seed, wave and cycle
FN: its result becomes wavePositions of the event "wave_activated"; entries are { x, y, waveType, waveIndex, layer }
jO: inferred: routes a boss ({ bossSW, size, maxSpeed, underFootprint, unreachable }) toward the player and returns [{ npcId, path }]; Yama calls it when resolvedConfig.pursuit

nh: npcTypeId: nh on the actor whose id is "yama"; looked up as getMonsterFormulaStats(nh, "Phase 3")
sh: npcTypeId: sh on the actor with archetypeId "voidflare"; error string "Missing monster formula stats for NPC 14179"
dh: its result is stored under the key attackKind ("melee_crush", "range_shadow", "magic_fire")
gh: its results are stored as waveConfig.seed and the void flare seed and seed pursuitRng and accuracyRng; inferred otherwise: a two-integer multiplicative hash
ch: the position of a spawned flare (event "voidflare_spawned") is picked from it by state.spawnIndex
mh: one entry is emitted as overheadText (event "overhead_text") when Yama is defeated
hh: getDefaultPlayerStart() returns a random tile between hh and fh; this is the lower corner
fh: getDefaultPlayerStart() returns a random tile between hh and fh; this is the upper corner

lh: its result is passed under the key beatInfo; it returns { isBeat, beatIndex, globalBeatOrdinal, isFireballBeat, isVoidFlareBeat, fireballBeatKind }
oh: the attackTimer of the "yama" definition returns it as nextAttackTick; inferred otherwise: the first beat tick after the given tick

kh: inferred: added to a burst's start tick to get the startTick of each of its three fireballs
Sh: applied to mechanics.duoSide; true for "player1" and "player2"
bh: inferred: keyed by player1/player2 (the duoSide values), then vertical/horizontal; an entry becomes a fireball's angle
yh: its result picks start: "vertical" or "horizontal" for a burst; a fixed start is compared with "vertical"
zh: its result is stored under the key angle
wh: its result is stored under the key instanceId
bN: the method activePhases() returns its result when scheduledEnabled; entries are { startTick, endTick, angle, instanceId }

_$: inferred: floor((maxHp - hp) * 100 / maxHp); handed out as damageBonusPercent under wretchedStrength and scales playerMinimumHit
F$: the fallback for every property of resolvedConfig.attackPattern ({ beatStartTick, beatIntervalTicks, beatsPerCycle, ... })
E$: inferred: floor(maxHp * fraction); only used for the boss hp values
N$: the fallback for resolvedConfig.boss.hp (a third of 2500)
G$: boss.hp of the config every contract is merged from (half of 2500)
U$: boss.hp of the contract with contractId "bloodied_blows" (half of 3000)
j$: boss.hp of the contract with contractId "glyphic_attenuation" (half of 2875)
q$: passed as levelOverrides when the contract has a contractId
Z$: inferred: the base every contract's encounter is merged from
Y$: its result is stored under the key encounter; inferred otherwise: merges attackPattern, autoAttacks, waves, fireballs, voidFlares and boss one level deep
X$: contractId: null and kind "yama_p3", the variant with id "no_contract" ("No Contract"); the fallback for this.contract
Q$: its value is "StaminaDepleted"; returned under the key fail
sV: handed out as variants: sV with variantLabel "Contract" in the registry entry of kind "yama_p3"

dV: handed out as controls: dV() and under variantControls in the registry entry of kind "yama_p3"

mV: its result is stored under the key attackPolicy ({ openingStyle, attackPattern })
hV: its onTick takes and returns (nextState) the state kept as actor.state.attackPolicy; error string "Unexpected Yama attack intent"
uV: inferred: returns the "yama" definition's state of an actor
vV: inferred: nulls queuedAttack, windup and latestAttack* and zeroes alternatingAttackCount; the definition's onDefeated
pV: it sets state.queuedAttack and counts state.alternatingAttackCount
kV: its result is pushed into npcAttacks
SV: error string "Yama cannot roll accuracy without formula stats"; result under the key accuracySucceeded

yV: applied to seeds.encounterSeed, seeds.fireballSeed and seeds.voidFlareSeed; inferred otherwise: an integer from 0 to 4294967295

zV: its result is assigned to this.state ({ run, fireballs, voidFlares, lifecycle })
LV: its value is "yama"; used as actorId, primaryActorId and in completionActorIds
DV: inferred: the movement options ({ size, maxSpeed, underFootprint, unreachable, canOccupy }) given to the pursuit routing when resolvedConfig.pursuit
HV: the last fallback for getArenaConfig().bounds ({ minX, maxX, minY, maxY })
MV: inferred: the entry of a list with the smallest squared distance to a position; gives position of the event "wave_activated"
cn: the registry entry of kind "yama_p3" constructs it (factory: () => new cn()); the module's file name
